Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: ONE production static 2D game nest sprite, level 1; an actual source asset, not a comparison board.
Image 1 is the current teal Spring tribe nest to redesign. Image 2 is the four-faction context, only for matching the painterly cartoon rendering and game camera, not a target to reproduce.
Primary request: replace the entire architecture of Image 1 with a distinct small natural SPRING. Keep the same opaque teal water material, mint highlights, dark teal contours, hand-painted shading, and elevated near-front 3/4 game view.
Design: a low WIDE oval spring pool with a deep flat open water surface in the middle, two broad elliptical ripple strokes on that surface. Its single continuous thick soft water rim winds around the pool as a flowing ribbon, smoothly raised on the rear left and dipping to a small broad spillway on the front right. Only one small low rounded sideways wave curl on the rear left edge. Quiet compact level-1 starter nest, 3-4 main readable masses, width roughly twice height. The center is a visible HORIZONTAL POOL, completely empty of sculpture. Relate to the creature through water material and curled edge language only.
Avoid: central droplet, water bead, egg, seed, unit silhouette, face, large pointed ornament, inward paired waves, petal/leaf/lotus, symmetrical cradle around a central object, heart-shaped gap, stone/metal/manmade fountain, high tower, particles, foam, bubbles.
Composition: one whole centered isolated sprite, generous transparent margins, clean genuine alpha background, no cast shadow/glow/ground, no text/labels.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production 2D game nest terrain underlay sprite, transparent PNG. Input image 1 is the accepted nest ground shape/layout reference. Input image 2 is the approved teal Spring tribe nest palette/material reference. Create the Spring tribe version of the ground underlay: a flat irregular roughly oval patch of damp cool gray-brown river silt with a shallow muted teal water wash in the center, soft curved stream marks, and a few small dark smooth pebbles plus sparse short muted reeds at the outer edge only. Mostly empty center to place a large water nest on top. Same painterly cartoon style and subtly elevated top-down game camera as the ground reference. No nest, characters, deep water rim, thick pool bowl, eyes, mouth, ice, glass, shiny sparkles, foam, bubbles, dramatic reflections, text or watermark. The palette is subdued supporting ground, not a bright teal building. Whole patch unclipped with clean true alpha around its irregular perimeter, no background or cast shadow. One source image only.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE standalone modular equipment sprite for a 2D game, actual transparent PNG, NOT a character or preview. Reference image 1 is the approved teal Spring tribe creature for palette, opaque water material, dark teal contour and painterly cartoon rendering. Reference image 2 indicates only the analogous equipment function and front/elevated game camera; do NOT copy its leaf material. The new equipment must be water-shaped, soft opaque teal, mint highlights, simple thick dark teal outlines. No body, face, eyes, mouth, clothing, text, labels, watermark, scene, shadow, ice, glass, metal, foam, floating bubbles or particles. Output the complete isolated equipment with generous transparent margins. It will be layered around the approved creature's pear-shaped torso, so the center/body area stays transparent wherever no equipment exists. Primary request: LEVEL 1 STRENGTH equipment. A symmetric pair of short thick water arms with rounded pincer-like hands, joined by a shallow narrow curved water carrying cradle at the lower front. Simple compact level 1 form. Hands sit at far left and right, softly split into two blunt gripping lobes. Clear empty transparent space above the low cradle and between the arms for the creature's torso and face. A low wide U silhouette, no tall spikes or receiver. Single equipment sprite.
